text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O seems to be putting on a tough front, trying to act how she did before the discussion of potentially being past her peak came up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every Umamusume at the Takarazuka Kinen is popular in their own right. There's Inari One, a racer from the local scene who's been gaining momentum, and Bamboo Memory, who's been improving by leaps and bounds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's even Yaeno Muteki, who Sakura Chiyono O competed against in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Faced with these rivals, Sakura Chiyono O tries to reassure herself by whispering that she'll be okay.
